@returns The address of the sender of the last message that [RecvUDPMsg](RecvUDPMsg) received, as text, or an empty string before the first message. Use it instead of [UDPMsgIP](UDPMsgIP) when the sender may use IPv6, as that returns 0 for these.
@param udp_stream  The stream.
@gap Not in the original, which only knows IPv4. See [IPv6](IPv6).
